title: Top 10 robotics developments of January 2026 - The Robot Report
content:
机器人行业在2026年1月开局迅猛。这一年以国际消费电子展（CES）拉开序幕，带来了铺天盖地的新闻，随后各公司达成里程碑并推出新系统，势头持续不减。

### ![2026年1月CES上展示的山猫RX3原型机。](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/bobcat-rx3-featured-300x195.jpg) 10. 斗山山猫发布RX3自主概念装载机
在CES上，斗山山猫公司推出了一系列人工智能驱动的自主和电气化技术，例如Rogue X3概念装载机。它旨在简化建筑设备的操作并提高生产力。电动山猫RX3已发展到第三代。

### ![Yomi S系统。](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Yomi-S-Rendering-full-featured-300x195.jpg) 9. Neocis的Yomi平台完成超过10万例截骨术
Neocis在2026年1月表示，临床医生已使用Yomi平台完成了大量骨骼手术。该公司还确认，Jay Neugarten医生现已成功完成了使用其第二代机器人系统Yomi S的首批临床病例。

### ![得益于数学和协作，像这种力和功率受限的手臂等实体人工智能将变得更智能，优傲机器人副总裁在2026年1月表示。](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/IMTS_AI_demo-7-300x192.jpg) 8. 优傲机器人对2026年1月及未来的四项实体人工智能预测
机器人行业正以前所未有的速度发展。优傲机器人人工智能机器人产品副总裁Anders Billesø Beck讨论了可能重新定义实体人工智能如何创造价值的四大趋势，其中包括更智能的数学。

### ![](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/ChatGPT-Image-Jan-26-2026-01_06_56-PM-2-e1769451866824-300x237.png) 7. 2026年机器人行业现状报告
机器人行业在2026年1月发现自己正处于一个转折点。经过多年的创新、大胆声明和引人注目的演示，讨论的重点正从机器人能做什么转向它们能在现实世界中可靠地做什么。

### ![2026年1月CES上展示的波士顿动力Atlas第3版英雄形象，带有播客标志。](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/episode-226-featured-300x195.jpg) 6. CES 2026机器人技术回顾；行业专家做出预测
在《机器人报告》播客第226集中，主持人Steve Crowe和Mike Oitzman讨论了CES 2026的最新机器人新闻和亮点。Steve参加了这次前身为国际消费电子展的活动，并分享了他对拉斯维加斯展示产品的评估。

### ![沃尔玛商店“巢穴”处的Wing无人机。](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Wing-Walmart-Nest-featured-300x195.jpg) 5. Wing将为另外150家沃尔玛门店提供无人机配送服务
Wing Aviation和沃尔玛计划在未来一年将无人机配送服务扩展到另外150家沃尔玛门店。Wing表示，这将使超过4000万美国人能够使用该服务。合作伙伴计划到2027年建立一个超过270个无人机配送点的网络。

### ![CES 2026上的新Atlas人形机器人。](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/69743-on-site-photo-3-300x185.jpeg) 4. 波士顿动力与谷歌重聚，共同开发下一代Atlas人形机器人
你可以卖掉波士顿动力，但无法完全离开它。在谷歌将这家机器人公司出售给软银近十年后，双方再次合作，于2026年1月宣布，DeepMind将利用其Gemini Robotics基础模型帮助Atlas人形机器人变得更智能。

### ![波士顿动力的Atlas站在佐治亚州的现代工厂，见于2026年1月的一期《60分钟》节目。](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Atlas-60_minutes-300x194.jpg) 2. 波士顿动力在2026年1月展示Atlas人形机器人在佐治亚州现代工厂工作
在《60分钟》节目中，波士顿动力展示了人工智能如何使其Atlas机器人能够在母公司现代汽车位于佐治亚州萨凡纳附近的新工厂执行任务。2025年，人形机器人开发商获得了高达46亿美元的投资。

### ![Rightbot开发了一套用于卸载卡车和拖车的系统。](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/rightbot-featured-300x195.jpg) 1. 亚马逊收购Rightbot，增强机器人配送与包装创新团队
卡车装卸是一项非常适合自动化的任务，因为它劳动强度大且在各种天气条件下进行。然而，竞争非常激烈。亚马逊已收购了Rightbot，该公司开发了一种用于非结构化负载处理的机器人。

metadata.rawMarkdown:
The robotics industry hit the ground running in January 2026. The year kicked off with CES, which brought an avalanche of news, and the momentum continued with companies hitting milestones and debuting new systems.
### [![The bobcat rx3 prototype, shown at CES in January 2026.](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/bobcat-rx3-featured-300x195.jpg)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/bobcat-rx3-featured.jpg) 10\. Doosan Bobcat unveils RX3 autonomous concept loader
At CES, Doosan Bobcat Inc. introduced a suite of AI-powered, autonomous, and electrified technologies such as the Rogue X3 concept loader. It is designed to simplify operations and increase productivity for construction equipment. The electric-powered Bobcat RX3 is in its third generation. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/doosen-bobcat-unveils-latest-rx3-concept-loader/).
### [![The Yomi S system.](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Yomi-S-Rendering-full-featured-300x195.jpg)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Yomi-S-Rendering-full-featured.jpg) 9\. Neocis’ Yomi platform completes over 100,000 osteotomies
Neocis said in January 2026 that clinicians have completed numerous bone surgeries using the Yomi platform. The company also confirmed that the first clinical cases using Yomi S, its second-generation robotic system, have now been successfully completed by Dr. Jay Neugarten. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/neocis-yomi-platform-completes-over-100000-osteotomies/).
### [![Physical AI such as this force- and power-limited arm will get smarter thanks to math and collaboration, said a UR VP in January 2026.](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/IMTS_AI_demo-7-300x192.jpg)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/IMTS_AI_demo-7.jpg) 8\. Four physical AI predictions for January 2026 — and beyond, from UR
The robotics industry is evolving faster than ever. Anders Billesø Beck, vice president for AI robotics products at Universal Robots discusses four trends that could redefine how physical AI creates value. They include smarter math. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/four-physical-ai-predictions-2026-beyond-universal-robots/).
### [![](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/ChatGPT-Image-Jan-26-2026-01_06_56-PM-2-e1769451866824-300x237.png)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/ChatGPT-Image-Jan-26-2026-01_06_56-PM-2-e1769451866824.png) 7\. State of robotics industry report 2026
The robotics industry found itself at an inflection point in January 2026. After years of innovation, bold claims, and headline-grabbing demonstrations, the conversation is shifting from what robots could do to what they can reliably do in the real world. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/state-of-robotics-industry-report-2026/).
### [![hero image of the boston dynamics atlas version 3 shown as CES in January 2026 with the podcast logo.](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/episode-226-featured-300x195.jpg)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/episode-226-featured.jpg) 6\. CES 2026 robotics recap; industry experts make predictions
In Episode 226 of _The Robot Report_ Podcast, hosts Steve Crowe and Mike Oitzman discuss the latest robotics news and highlights from CES 2026. Steve attended the event, formerly the Consumer Electronics Show, and he shares his assessment of products demonstrated in Las Vegas. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/ces-2026-robotics-recap-industry-experts-make-predictions/).
### [![Wing drones at a "nest" at at Walmart store.](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Wing-Walmart-Nest-featured-300x195.jpg)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Wing-Walmart-Nest-featured.jpg) 5\. Wing is bringing drone delivery to 150 more Walmart stores
Wing Aviation and Walmart plan to expand drone deliveries to 150 more Walmart stores over the next year. Wing said this will give more than 40 million Americans access to the service. The partners plan will establish a network of over 270 drone delivery locations by 2027. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/wing-brings-drone-delivery-to-150-more-walmart-stores/).
### [![New Atlas humanoid at CES 2026.](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/69743-on-site-photo-3-300x185.jpeg)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/69743-on-site-photo-3.jpeg) 4\. Boston Dynamics, Google reunite on next-gen Atlas humanoid
You can sell Boston Dynamics, but you can’t fully quit it. Nearly a decade after Google sold the robotics company to SoftBank, the two are working together again, announcing in January 2026 that DeepMind will help make the Atlas humanoid smarter with its Gemini Robotics foundation models. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/boston-dynamics-google-reunite-on-next-gen-atlas-humanoid/).
### [![Boston Dynamics' Atlas stands at a Hyundai plant in Georgia, as seen in a January 2026 episode of 60 Minutes.](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Atlas-60_minutes-300x194.jpg)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Atlas-60_minutes.jpg) 2\. Boston Dynamics shows Atlas humanoid working at Georgia Hyundai plant in January 2026
On _60 Minutes_, Boston Dynamics demonstrated how AI is enabling its Atlas robot to conduct tasks at new factory of parent company Hyundai near Savannah, Ga. As much as $4.6 billion was invested in humanoid developers in 2025. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/boston-dynamics-shows-atlas-humanoid-working-georgia-hyundai-plant/).
### [![Rightbot developed a system for unloading trucks and trailers.](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/rightbot-featured-300x195.jpg)](https://www.therobotreport.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/12/rightbot-featured.jpg) 1\. Amazon acquires Rightbot, adds to Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation team
Truck loading and unloading is a task ripe for automation because it is strenuous and happens in all kinds of weather. However, competition is stiff. Amazon has acquired Rightbot, which has developed a robot for unstructured load handling. [Read more](https://www.therobotreport.com/amazon-acquires-rightbot-adds-robotics-delivery-packaging-innovation-team/).
